title: Figure 23: MEMS microelectrode array implanted into the cortex of a rat brain
description: Close-up color photograph of an exposed rat brain surface with blood vessels visible, showing a thin probe with lead wires inserted into the cortex. Caption reads "Figure 23. A MEMS Microelectrode Array Implanted Into the Cortex of a Rat Brain. The lead wires from the device can be seen. (NeuroNexus Inc.)" Text below begins a section on retinal devices using BioMEMS.
